admission.justification: Preparing every seat once preserves direct peer identity without charging idle siblings an opening turn.

alternatives.option: One Manager prepares sibling seats; only seats with work open.
alternatives.reason: Preparing every seat once preserves direct peer identity without charging idle siblings an opening turn.

alternatives.option: Stagger Worker/Reviewer and create Curator at first freeze.
alternatives.reason: Staggered creation makes peer presence depend on relay timing and opens early idle seats needlessly.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A changed approved leaf-role topology or host creation contract makes dormant prepared seats unsuitable.

consequences: Ordinary single-role starts and the may-start matrix remain; the owning Manager uses the public set operation.
context: Early Reviewer value and stale idle opening turns require one coherent leaf-start shape.
